name: mixed_armor_sweep
description: Manual helper for comparing Glock and MP5 against armored and protected-head dummy states. It organizes review notes but does not settle balance questions by itself.

steps.name: glock_vest
steps.operatorNote: Compare torso hits against one headshot attempt so the armored torso path is represented.

steps.name: mp5_vest
steps.operatorNote: Capture one short burst, one moving spray, and a torso-versus-head comparison against armor.

steps.name: glock_vest_headprotected
steps.operatorNote: Deliberately compare torso hits and protected-head attempts for the Glock path.

steps.name: mp5_vest_headprotected
steps.operatorNote: Capture both controlled and longer bursts, then compare torso and protected-head attempts.
